text:
kevin: Quick Q about the /v1/generate API error semantics — are we standardizing on 4xx for client/input validation only and 5xx for infra/runtime? Planning to change some validation returns in PR #4321.
kevin: @sasha @aj tagging since this touches SDK behavior and retry logic.
sasha: Yep — validation -> 400 with a structured error object (error_code, message, optional fields). Non-retryable.
sasha: Example we want in spec:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "validation",
    "code": "invalid_prompt",
    "message": "Prompt exceeded 64k chars",
    "fields": ["prompt"]
  }
}
```
aj: For rate limits return 429 with `Retry-After` header. For infra/degraded conditions use 503. Both 429 and 503 are retryable with client backoff. For 5xx responses include `request_id` and `server_timestamp` in the body so support can correlate.
oli: Small caveat: some model OOMs currently bubble up as 400 from the runtime. We should map OOM/alloc failures to 503 so clients know it's transient. See my comment on PR #4321.
maya: Can we add a short enum of `error.code` values to the OpenAPI and a note for SDKs to map codes -> typed exceptions? Otherwise SDKs might infer from status only and mis-handle retriable cases.
kevin: Plan: I'll update OpenAPI + changelog. PR #4321 will: remap OOM -> 503, add `error.code` and `request_id` fields, and document retry semantics. @sasha can you sign off on the schema once I push?
sasha: on it. Quick review note: do not auto-retry non-idempotent endpoints. POST /v1/generate is user-facing; we should encourage clients to use idempotency-key if they want automatic retries.
aj: Agreed — we should support `Idempotency-Key` header for server-side dedupe. Add it to the spec and SDKs.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T02:00Z for canary-42 (will run in us-west1 for 10% traffic).
kevin: pinging reviewers for CR: @sasha @aj @oli — also need docs owner for SDK bump.
maya: I'll take docs and release notes. Will coordinate SDK changelog entries.
ci-bot: Lint passed for PR #4321; integration tests failing on a long-prompt timeout (flaky). Adding a test tag so we can ignore until we fix timeouts.
kevin: Thanks all — I'll wait for approvals then merge tomorrow morning. This isn't a breaking change for most clients but status codes will change for a few edge cases; we'll add migration notes and a short heads-up email to enterprise customers pre-deploy.
sasha: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
aj: LGTM once OOM mapping test added.
oli: I'll add `error_code` to our access logs and alerts so we can track spikes in specific codes.
maya: I'll draft the release note paragraph and add a short example for SDK migration guides.
kevin: Closing loop: after merge I'll post a short thread in #announcements and tag enterprise-eng to send the email.
kevin: Also cc-ing billing in case rate-limit messaging needs clarity for customers on quotas.
sasha: Thanks — gonna approve once tests are green.
kevin: Appreciate it — will follow up in the morning.
